name: SmartSalesBoost
author: Logik Labs

sections.description:
🎯 SmartSalesBoost is a powerful WooCommerce extension that enables store owners to create and manage dynamic cross-selling campaigns. Increase your average order value by offering targeted product recommendations both before and after purchase.

✨ Key Features

  • 🛍️ Pre-purchase campaigns with shortcode support
  • 🎁 Post-purchase recommendations on the Thank You page
  • 📊 Easy-to-use campaign management dashboard
  • 🎯 Dynamic product selection
  • 💰 Customizable discounts for cross-sell items
  • 📈 Campaign performance tracking
  • 📱 Responsive design for all devices

🔥 Campaign Types

  1. Pre-Purchase Campaigns

    • 🎯 Display targeted offers on any page using shortcodes
    • 🛒 Trigger based on specific products in cart
    • 💯 Customize discounts per product
    • 📋 Copy shortcodes with one click

  2. Post-Purchase Campaigns

    • ✨ Automatic display on Thank You page
    • 🎁 Personalized recommendations
    • 🏷️ Special post-purchase offers
    • 🔄 Increase repeat purchases

🚀 Usage

  1. 📱 Create campaigns from the WooCommerce > SmartSalesBoost menu
  2. 🎯 Choose between pre-purchase or post-purchase campaigns
  3. 🛍️ Select trigger products and combo offers
  4. 💰 Set custom discounts and display options
  5. ✅ Activate and monitor performance

For pre-purchase campaigns, use the shortcode:
[smartsalesboost campaign=”campaign_id”]

Support

📧 For support queries, feature requests, and bug reports, please contact us at support@logiklabs.com

Credits

🏢 SmartSalesBoost is developed and maintained by Logik Labs.
sections.installation:
1. 📥 Upload the ‘smartsalesboost’ folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. ✅ Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. 🎯 Navigate to WooCommerce > SmartSalesBoost to create your first campaign
sections.faq:
🔌 Is WooCommerce required?

✅ Yes, SmartSalesBoost requires WooCommerce 4.0 or higher to be installed and active.

🎯 How do I display a pre-purchase campaign?

📋 Use the shortcode [smartsalesboost campaign=”campaign_id”] where you want the campaign to appear. The campaign ID can be found in your campaign list.

💰 Can I set different discounts for different products?

✅ Yes, you can set individual discounts (percentage or fixed amount) for each product in your campaign.

🎁 Where do post-purchase campaigns appear?

📱 Post-purchase campaigns automatically appear on the WooCommerce Thank You page after order completion.

screenshots.caption: Campaign Dashboard - Overview dashboard showing total campaigns, pre-sale campaigns, and performance metrics with a clean, modern interface using our brand colors (#0D47A1, #00ACC1).
Pre-purchase Campaign Display - Frontend view of pre-purchase campaigns showing product cards with original prices, discounts, and "Add to Cart" buttons in a responsive grid layout.

Pre-purchase Campaign Admin Display - Intuitive campaign creation interface with settings for campaign name, display title, and campaign type selection. Features our signature deep blue headers and teal action buttons.

Campaigns List - Campaign management screen showing all campaigns with status toggles, shortcode copying functionality, and quick action buttons. Includes statistics cards with dashicons for visual appeal.
Post Purchase Display - Thank You page display featuring personalized product recommendations with dynamic pricing calculations and attractive product cards.
